subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to provider HTTP config

question: Should Fal image and video generation honor an explicit `models.providers.fal.request.allowPrivateNetwork` setting, or must these capabilities always deny private-network destinations while honoring only safer request-policy fields?
rationale: The implementation correctly forwards the full sanitized request object, but that object can intentionally broaden destination reach and repository evidence does not establish the permanent Fal capability policy.

options.title: Honor explicit operator policy
options.body: Allow the complete sanitized Fal request policy, including private-network opt-in, while keeping default behavior denied and requiring controlled transport coverage.

options.title: Retain hard destination denial
options.body: Forward headers, proxy, TLS, and other approved policy while explicitly forcing private-network access off for Fal generation.

recommendation.title: Honor explicit operator policy
recommendation.body: Allow the complete sanitized Fal request policy, including private-network opt-in, while keeping default behavior denied and requiring controlled transport coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing signal for recent provider transport-policy and security-boundary decisions.
